notToBeConfusedWith.name: Peppermint
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A different mint-family plant with a menthol coolness rather than wintergreen's sweeter, more medicinal note; the two are not interchangeable in a root beer syrup.

forms.label: Dried leaf
forms.sourceNote: No nutrition dataset carries dried wintergreen leaf, and none is needed here: the leaf is steeped for its methyl salicylate aroma and strained back out, contributing nothing measurable to the finished syrup.
